_comment: CURATOR-OWNED INPUT (Addendum A.2 Tier 2, A.8). This file is an editorial artifact, not a generated one. Ingestion VALIDATES this metadata against the corpus; it must never DECIDE it. The generated counterpart is build/<brand>/document-manifest.json, which ingestion writes.
corpus_status_note: BETA CANDIDATE - PREPARED LOCALLY, NOT DEPLOYED. This index promotes the verified Batch 1 documents into a production candidate. It has NOT been ingested to, uploaded to, or connected with the live production vector store, which remains unchanged and continues to serve the existing 330 GTC/GTS beta. The three original production documents keep their document_id, filename and citation identity so existing citation routes stay valid. Supersession, authority and precedence are RECORDED AS OBSERVED, never decided by Autovision; the Ferrari Judging Committee supplies and approves the production corpus (A.8).

page_text_overrides.reason: The multi-column wheel-options table was flattened into the wrong reading order by PDF text extraction. This transcription preserves the visually verified row and code associations.
page_text_overrides.text:
RACING EXTERIOR INTERIOR EQUIPMENT
EXTERIOR AND COLOURS
20” diamond finished forged rim (Modis code RSFD)
Please note that a further variant of the sport forged wheels is now available for Ferrari 458 Italia.
The new rims have the same style of the painted forged wheels (Modis code RMSV) but they are enriched with a sporty two-tone aspect; Iron Grey Metallic 780 painting for the inner part of the spokes and diamond polishing treatment for the outer part of the rim.
Below we summarize the optional wheels available for Ferrari 458 Italia.
18
Standard rim
Standard dark chromed rim
(Modis Code RICS)
Silver painted forged rim
(Modis code RMSV)
Diamond finished forged rim
(Modis code RSFD)
Dark Grey Metallic 780 painted forged rim
(Special equipment)
JUNE ORDERS
All Personalization & Atelier Communications are available on the MODISCS portal
Release July 2010
